{
  "dataset_name": "blood_transfusion",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "v1_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized V1 (recency) using training mean and std for scale-normalized distance contribution.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Equalizes feature scale so KNN distances are not dominated by V3.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 - 9.245535714285714) / 8.051590219959847"
    },
    {
      "name": "v2_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized V2 (frequency) using training mean and std.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Puts frequency on a comparable scale for neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V2 - 5.741071428571429) / 5.407081229597849"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_log_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed V3 (monetary) then standardized to reduce skew before distance computation.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents large monetary values from dominating Euclidean distance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(V3) - 7.0) / 1.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "v4_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized V4 (time since first donation).",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Balances tenure feature scale within distance metric.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V4 - 34.879464285714285) / 23.75335930525278"
    },
    {
      "name": "avg_volume_per_donation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average monetary volume per donation event (V3 / V2), a stable per-row ratio.",
      "value_range": [50.0, 500.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures donation magnitude consistency, useful for similarity grouping.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 / np.maximum(V2, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "donation_rate_per_month",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Donations per month of tenure (V2 / V4), normalized engagement rate.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes donor engagement intensity into geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V2 / np.maximum(V4, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "active_tenure_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of tenure since last donation, V1 / V4, measuring inactivity proportion.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Separates lapsed vs active donors in neighborhood space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V1 / np.maximum(V4, 1), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "recency_to_frequency_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "V1 divided by V2, time since last donation relative to total count.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights donors whose recency is high relative to frequency.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 / np.maximum(V2, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_median_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance in standardized space to a generic central (median-like) prototype at origin.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct distance signal to dataset centroid aids KNN ranking.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((V1 - 9.245535714285714) / 8.051590219959847) ** 2 + ((V2 - 5.741071428571429) / 5.407081229597849) ** 2 + ((np.log1p(V3) - 7.0) / 1.0) ** 2 + ((V4 - 34.879464285714285) / 23.75335930525278) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_low_activity_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized Euclidean distance to an unsupervised low-activity prototype (high recency, low frequency, low monetary, short tenure).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides geometric anchor distinguishing infrequent donors.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((V1 - 20.0) / 8.051590219959847) ** 2 + ((V2 - 2.0) / 5.407081229597849) ** 2 + ((np.log1p(V3) - 6.2) / 1.0) ** 2 + ((V4 - 20.0) / 23.75335930525278) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_high_activity_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized Euclidean distance to an unsupervised high-activity prototype (low recency, high frequency, high monetary, long tenure).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Anchors active donors as a distinct cluster in distance space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((V1 - 2.0) / 8.051590219959847) ** 2 + ((V2 - 15.0) / 5.407081229597849) ** 2 + ((np.log1p(V3) - 8.2) / 1.0) ** 2 + ((V4 - 60.0) / 23.75335930525278) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "donor_engagement_quality",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic ordinal score (0=dormant, 1=occasional, 2=regular, 3=committed) inferred from joint pattern of recency, frequency, and tenure indicators in the row.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "semantic_cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cluster-like indicator that sharpens KNN neighborhood boundaries between behavioral regimes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
